# FINO

> The future of work is human. FINO is a coaching, consulting, and design practice founded by Anna Milaeva and Dario Giuffrida, applying Internal Family Systems (IFS) and organizational psychology to leaders, teams, and the businesses they build.

FINO combines deep inner work with practical execution. We coach leaders and teams using Internal Family Systems, run group programs and offsites, build websites for practitioners, integrate AI thoughtfully into people-first organizations, and lead transformational expeditions in nature. The premise: lasting change in how teams work together comes from change in how people relate to themselves first.

## Founders

- [About FINO](https://fino.website/about/): Anna Milaeva (IFS Level 3 Practitioner, Certified Deep Transformational Coach, 10+ years in startup operations, author of the novel Already In A Meeting, personal site https://annamilaeva.com) and Dario Giuffrida (Organizational Psychologist trained at Sapienza University, IFS Practitioner, medicine man with 20+ years of practice)

## Core offerings

- [IFS Coaching for Leaders](https://fino.website/coaching/): one-on-one and group coaching using Internal Family Systems for clarity, resilience, and Self-leadership
- [Self-leadership Circles](https://fino.website/circles/): an 8-week IFS group program for teams to build a shared language for staying grounded under pressure
- [Self-leadership Circles for Legal Teams](https://fino.website/self-leadership-circles-legal/): the 8-week program adapted for law firms and legal professionals
- [Self-leadership Circles for Healthcare Teams](https://fino.website/self-leadership-circles-healthcare/): the 8-week program adapted for healthcare workers and clinical teams
- [Transformational Team Offsites](https://fino.website/offsites/): immersive retreats in nature combining IFS, somatic practice, and ancestral wisdom
- [Self-led AI Integration](https://fino.website/self-led-ai-integration/): 60–90 day custom engagements helping organizations integrate AI from a Self-led, IFS-informed foundation
- [FINO Studio · Website Design for Practitioners](https://fino.website/studio/): bespoke websites for therapists, coaches, and independent practitioners; we start with a deep interview, then build a site that sounds like you
- [Operations Consulting](https://fino.website/projects/): fractional operations and tooling for the work that comes after the inner work

## The book

- [Already In A Meeting](https://annamilaeva.com/book): a novel by co-founder Anna Milaeva, subtitle "A story about the parts of us that never stop working". Five colleagues at a startup in trouble, and the second meeting that runs inside each person while the first one happens. Available in paperback and ebook (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HD3GVY6Z/).
- FINO uses the novel as an entry point with teams that are not ready for the full 8-week program: everyone reads it, then FINO facilitates one session on which of the five characters is showing up in the team's own meetings. It runs in an afternoon and is a way to find out whether Self-leadership Circles are a fit.

## Expeditions

- [FINO Expeditions](https://expeditions.fino.website/): transformational journeys combining IFS coaching with ancestral medicine traditions. Currently open: Cocorná, Colombia, December 7–13, 2026 (Yagé ceremonies with the Cofán lineage, Chakana ceremony in the Andean tradition, IFS arc across 9 weeks)

## Contact

- Inquiries are routed through the contact form on each offering page
- All applications for the expeditions go through https://expeditions.fino.website/

## Voice and audience

FINO writes for working professionals, healers, therapists, lawyers, doctors, founders, and team leads who are doing inner work and want it to land in their organizations. The voice is sober, direct, grounded in lived experience, and explicitly avoids guru positioning, toxic positivity, and marketing buzzwords.
